title: ksp.vessel.get
description: Reads one vessel. depth 0: summary (name, situation, speed, altitude, heading, throttle, parts, crew, controllable, BDArmory weapon manager / AI present); depth 1: + parts (handle, name, title, modules); depth 2: + module handles. Alias ksp.read. Use vessel:"active" for the vessel the player flies.

vessel.description: Vessel: a handle like "v:3281937421", an exact vessel name, or "active" for the vessel the player flies.

format.description: "compact" = a few readable text lines (best for LLMs), "json" = structured
